description:
Fantom Corporation is seeking a DevOps Engineer Level 0 to support software and system deployments, Linux administration, network operations, and containerized infrastructure. This position supports secure, reliable operations across network, cloud, and virtualized environments through automation, troubleshooting, and deployment support.
Location: Onsite, assigned worksite to be confirmed
Schedule: Full Time, with 24/7 call-in availability for critical operational issues
Clearance: Fully cleared before starting, with a polygraph completed within the last seven years
Travel: Required for system installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting

Key Responsibilities
 

 Analyze user requirements to define software design and performance requirements.

 Develop new applications and enhance existing software using technologies appropriate to the assigned development focus.

 Support Python/C++ software development or build web interfaces using Vue.js or React.

 Develop and integrate application interfaces, REST services, and database connections.

 Debug software, resolve defects, and improve application performance.

 Integrate software into new or modified systems and operating environments.

 Develop database queries and interfaces to data repositories.

 Develop and implement algorithms that meet functional and performance requirements.

 Assist with software testing, document results, and verify compliance with design requirements.

 Write and review software and system documentation.

 Collaborate with users and systems engineers to analyze workflows, data usage, and technical issues.

 Recommend improvements to development processes, documentation, and software reuse.

 Provide technical coordination or team leadership as appropriate.




Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent MD polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 


 

 
 Seven years of software engineering experience on programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity.



 
 Meet the requirements for either development focus:

 Python/C++ Development: Experience with Python, C++, and Git, plus basic RF experience or knowledge.

 User Interface Development: Experience with Vue.js, Vuetify, Leaflet, Elasticsearch, Node.js, REST, gRPC, and MongoDB.



 
 Ability to translate documented requirements into software designs and working applications.



 
 Experience troubleshooting, testing, maintaining, and enhancing software.



 
 Ability to work independently and collaborate with engineering teams.



 
 Meet the education requirement or applicable experience substitution.



 
 Be fully cleared before the start date.






Education
 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university.

 Four additional years of software engineering experience on projects with similar software processes may substitute for the bachelor’s degree, for a total of eleven years.




Preferred Qualifications
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools.

 Experience with Kubernetes, including basic kubectl commands.

 Experience with Docker, Make, and Buildx.

 Experience with React and WebSocket.

 Familiarity with technologies used by the other development focus.

 Experience with processing-intensive analytics, large datasets, or real-time applications.


 #CJ















  



















  



Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
